rule: Prior semantic inspection of a BugsInPy repair, fixed production source, developer patch, or solution narrative makes that case exposure-ineligible for the strongest blind-natural E3 claim. Runtime/test qualification alone does not.
boundary: This is a frozen known-exposure denylist, not a claim that every unlisted case has never appeared anywhere. A mechanically selected candidate receives a separate fixed-procedure retrospective exposure audit before use in the causal successor. If that audit finds prior semantic exposure, append a new evidence record and rerun under a new run identifier; never silently substitute another case.
